name: Massachusetts Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Massachusetts
city: Massachusetts (2026 session at Stonehill College, Easton)
what_you_do: Spend a week running a pretend city and state. You campaign, write and debate bills, and learn how local and state government work.
grades: Finishing or just finished junior year of high school
who_can_apply: Girls who are finishing or just finished their junior year. You must be a U.S. citizen or legal inhabitant. Documents are needed at check-in. You need an interest in government, strong leadership and above average grades. A sponsor is needed.
pay_detail: No pay. Participants are sponsored by an American Legion post, Auxiliary unit, school or community group. The student cost is not stated on the pages read.
deadline_text: The 2026 session was June 13 to June 19, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Find a sponsor (a Legion post, Auxiliary unit, school or other group). Once your sponsor sends your name and email, the site emails you the online registration form. If you have no sponsor, fill out the sponsor request form on the Registration Forms page.
notes: Girls only. You can also send in an optional bill to be considered by the mock state Congress. The program says it is run by volunteers. Email Director.massgirlsstate@gmail.com with questions.
